articles.zh: 意见不合也 OK 吗？
body: This programme asks whether disagreeing with others is always a bad thing, or whether it can actually be healthy.
这期节目探讨：和别人意见不合是否一定是坏事，还是说它其实可能有益健康。
The hosts discuss how modern society often pressures people to avoid conflict, yet honest disagreement can lead to better ideas.
主持人聊到，现代社会常给人压力去回避冲突，但坦诚的分歧反而能催生更好的点子。
Listeners learn vocabulary about expressing opinions politely and keeping respect during a debate.
听众能学到在辩论中礼貌表达观点、同时保持尊重的实用词汇。
The episode looks at why riding a bike could be one of the simplest ways to improve both health and the environment.
这期节目探讨：骑车为何可能是同时改善健康和环境的简单方式之一。
Phil and Pippa talk about city designs that make cycling safer, and the habits that stop people from riding.
Phil 和 Pippa 聊到让骑行更安全的城市规划，以及阻碍人们骑车的一些习惯。
You will pick up words about transport, exercise and daily routines in English.
你会学到与交通、运动和日常作息相关的英语表达。

articles.en: Kick the can down the road
body: This idiom describes putting off a difficult problem instead of solving it now.
这个习语形容把棘手的问题往后拖，而不是现在就解决。
The presenters give examples from politics and everyday life where people delay tough decisions.
主持人举了政治和日常生活中的例子，说明人们如何推迟艰难的决定。
You will hear how to use this phrase naturally in conversation.
你会听到这个短语在日常对话中如何自然地使用。
tips: to kick the can down the road
把问题往后拖、暂缓处理

body: When someone cuts corners, they do a job quickly and cheaply by missing out important steps.
当一个人 cut corners，意思是他为了图快图省而省掉重要步骤。
The programme shows why this shortcut often causes bigger problems later on.
节目说明了这种捷径为何常在日后引发更大的麻烦。
Learners get clear examples of how to use the phrase at work or at home.
学习者能拿到在工作或家中使用这个短语的清晰例子。
This phrase means something is hard to believe or not quite true.
这个短语表示某事难以置信、或不太站得住脚。
The hosts explain situations where you might say a claim is a bit of a stretch.
主持人解释了在哪些场景下你会说某个说法有点牵强。
It is a handy expression for disagreeing politely without being rude.
这是一个很有用的表达，能让你礼貌地表示不认同而不失礼。
